تستحثثن (form X)
# تَسْتَحْثِثْنَ (tastaḥṯiṯna) /tas.taħ.θiθ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَحَثَّ (istaḥaṯṯa)
# تُسْتَحْثَثْنَ (tustaḥṯaṯna) /tus.taħ.θaθ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَحَثَّ (istaḥaṯṯa)
